summary: On May 16, 2024, Veenker organized a 'unity statement' at the Palo Alto City Council bringing pro-Palestinian and pro-Israel residents together to de-escalate debate over Gaza cease-fire demands. The action positioned her as a mediator seeking to reconcile both camps rather than as an advocate pressing for the cease-fire or a critic of Israel's military campaign, a de-escalation posture that frames the dispute as a balance between two equivalent claims.
